Hi Nate!

There is one step that needs to come before the verification step and it's one everyone forgets but it's very important because it's actually mandatory by law. That is web accessibility. As beautiful as your site is, it needs to be web accessible for people with disabilities. This means that your site needs to be able to be browsed using keyboard navigation. Your site needs to be accurately read through screen readers. Your site needs to have certain contrast values, etc. As I said this is mandatory by law and is actually stated in the Act of Human Rights. A lot of big companies, including Disney, already had major lawsuits on their hands, which they lost because certain parts of their website weren't accessible for people with disabilities.
